I boarded the ship around 8:00 PM, and then around 1:00 PM the next day...
So you arrive just after noon.
It was my first time spending such a long time on a ship, so I was worried about getting seasick, but it turns out I'm actually fine with it.
I love looking at the ocean, so I got a room with a view...
And I just spent the whole trip staring at the sea from my room. It was so enjoyable.
Did you have dinner on the ship too?
Yes, yes! It was a buffet, but...
Since the ship was swaying, everyone was being incredibly careful while carrying their food.

Yeah, that was interesting to see. There were quite a few solo travelers, but because of the timing, there were so many families. I kept thinking how fun it must be for kids to have an experience like that while I watched them and ate my meal.
What did you do once you got to Hokkaido?
Well, I went to my lodgings, and...
